(Source: [3]; Colored boxes are added) An important aspect of such a systems that is not shown in the diagram is a consent management which controls the lifetime of the user consents for access/change data. The VISS specification proposes the External Consent Framework for consent man- agement, but it does not specify how it obtains consent status. For tampering protection and for protecting against man-in-the-middle attacks on the in-vehicle communication between the Automotive API Gateway and AUTOSAR ap- plications the following technologies can be used. They are all configurable using AUTOSAR methodology: • MACsec, • IPsec, • SecOC,
